title: Transported composite counit on full subcategories
statement: Let A,B,C be categories and PA,PB,PC object properties. Let F:A→B, G:B→A, H:B→C, I:C→B, J:A→C and R:C→A be functors. Suppose F,G and H,I restrict to adjunctions on the indicated full subcategories [def-sp-coordinate-adjunction-categories]. Suppose J,R preserve the indicated properties, alpha:PA.ι⋙F⋙H≅PA.ι⋙J and beta:I⋙G≅R. Compose the restricted adjunctions, cancel the fully faithful inclusions in alpha and beta, and transport along these isomorphisms to construct J left adjoint to R on the full subcategories. Its ambient counit at K is J(beta.inv_K), then alpha.inv at G(I(K)), then H applied to the first counit at I(K), then the second counit at K. This is CompositeEquation for this explicitly constructed pair.

source.place: Local pairs and Levels; explicit categorical details of the original coordinate argument

proof.text: Compose the two restricted adjunctions using Adjunction.comp, cancel the full inclusions, and transport both functors. Unfold the counit definitions and use comp_counit_app; the full inclusion maps preserve composition and cancel its preimages, giving the displayed equality.

theorem restrictedComposite_counit
    (a : RestrictedPair PA PB F G) (b : RestrictedPair PB PC H I)
    (hJ : ∀ M : PA.FullSubcategory, PC (J.obj M.obj))
    (hR : ∀ K : PC.FullSubcategory, PA (R.obj K.obj))
    (alpha : PA.ι ⋙ F ⋙ H ≅ PA.ι ⋙ J) (beta : I ⋙ G ≅ R) :
    CompositeEquation PA PB PC F G H I J R a b
      (restrictedComposite a b hJ hR alpha beta) alpha beta
